subject: SummitCore runway confirmation & fleet mapping for Q3 onboarding
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: SummitCore runway mapping request

Hi team,

SummitCore (DEAL-2029-1034-SUM) is moving to late-stage and has asked for a firm runway check so they can lock their go-live date. Finance is asking us to confirm what we can guarantee (and where) before they sign the reserved capacity addendum.

Key asks: 
- Can Ops map current dedicated GPU availability for the US-west and US-east pools for the period Jul 1 - Sep 30? Include per-cluster free slots and typical provisioning lead time.
- Any quota constraints if we need to commit ~48 A100-equivalent slots with 90% sustained utilization?
- Risks: scheduled maintenance windows, major backlog on provisioning, or other deals that overlap this window.

I need a short one-pager (bullet form) + the raw snapshot by COB Wed so I can send a calm, data-driven note to SummitCore. Attaching the template they asked for.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: SummitCore runway mapping request

Avery — attaching the fleet snapshot. High level summary below. Attachment: fleet_capacity_snapshot_20290521.xlsx

Summary (US-wide, July 1 - Sep 30 window):
- US-west (primary): 62 A100-equivalent slots free; baseline provisioning lead time: 3 business days for dedicated pool joins.
- US-east (secondary): 28 A100-equivalent slots free; baseline provisioning lead time: 5 business days.
- Peak-week cushion (rolling): ~12 slots across regions, can be reserved as burst capacity but would require a short-term rebalancing (1–2 days).
- Known constraints: two infra upgrades scheduled the week of Aug 19 that may reduce available slots by ~8 during a 48-hour window; we can set blackout windows if SummitCore wants to avoid that period.

Sustained 90% utilization: fine from a throughput perspective, but SLA for dedicated burst requests degrades if we commit more than 72 slots concurrently across regions. If SummitCore wants strict guarantees for 48 sustained slots + 24 burst, recommend a partial reserved commit (48 reserved + burst pool of 12).

I'll also note the provisioning path: dedicated capacity attach requires confirmation of VM size + image; ops can pre-stage images to shave a day off lead time.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@summitcore.ai>
Cc: onboarding@summitcore.ai, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: SummitCore: preliminary fleet mapping + next steps to lock runway (DEAL-2029-1034-SUM)

Samira —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Quick follow-up from our side with a snapshot of what we can commit while we finalize commercial terms. 

Short summary: based on current fleet and scheduled maintenance, Redwood can offer the following for the Jul 1 - Sep 30 window:
- Reserved baseline: 48 A100-equivalent slots (primary allocation in US-west).
- Burst pool: 12 slots across regions (on-demand rebalancing; subject to short blackout windows during infra upgrades).
- Provisioning lead time: 3 business days for US-west primary nodes (we can pre-stage images to target 1 business day once you sign the attach).

Action items we need from you to lock the runway:
1) Confirm your target go-live date (proposed in our call: Jul 15).
2) Confirm acceptance of the proposed split (48 baseline / 12 burst).
3) Sign the capacity addendum (we can send a DocuSign link today) — once we receive the signed addendum and 30% of the committed monthly, Ops will tag the fleet and pre-stage images.

I've attached the fleet snapshot and a short sizing note from ops. Ben (cc'd) will be your ops contact for the pre-staging.

If you want a hard blackout-free guarantee for late Aug, we can do a short-term re-route plan but that would increase the monthly unit price slightly (we can give exact numbers in the addendum).

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: fleet_capacity_snapshot_20290521.xlsx, summitcore_sizing_notes_20290522.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira@summitcore.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: onboarding@summitcore.ai
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitCore: preliminary fleet mapping + next steps to lock runway (DEAL-2029-1034-SUM)

Avery — thanks for the clear summary and for pulling the snapshot together. Quick answers: 
- Go-live target: Jul 15 is our target. We need baseline capacity guaranteed by Jul 8 for final validation runs.
- Baseline/burst split: Confirming 48 baseline / 12 burst is acceptable.
- Blackout window: we prefer avoiding the Aug 19 maintenance window — if there is a small premium to route around that day we are open to it (please include the delta in the addendum).

Please send the DocuSign and we will get internal procurement to start the 30% deposit process once terms are in place.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
SummitCore AI
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@summitcore.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitCore: preliminary fleet mapping + next steps to lock runway (DEAL-2029-1034-SUM)

Samira — happy to confirm operationally. Concrete next steps from Ops: 
1) We will create a dedicated allocation tag for DEAL-2029-1034-SUM in US-west (48 slots) and mark 12 slots as burst candidate across US-east/west.
2) Pre-stage the SummitCore image on the US-west cluster tomorrow (May 25) to hit your Jul 8 validation requirement. This reduces provisioning lead-time to ~1 business day once the addendum and deposit are in.
3) We will add a blackout-avoidance plan for the Aug 19 maintenance window and include the small routing premium as an optional line in the DocuSign.

Operational notes: the dedicated tag will appear in the fleet snapshot and be non-evictable for the committed period once the reservation is active. If procurement needs a short test window before the deposit, let us know and we can open a 48-hour validation lease that doesn't consume billing commitments.

I'll sync with Marissa on the DocuSign lines.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
